system.description:
Grants the user control over a small extra-dimensional space for storage, habitation, or narrative purposes. Typically requires Dimension Walk or Portal unless granted via an accessible item.
Level 1: Tiny dimension (10 cm radius)
Level 2: Small dimension (1 m radius)
Level 3: Moderately sized dimension (10 m radius)
Level 4: Building-sized dimension (100 m radius)
Level 5: Neighbourhood-sized dimension (1 km radius)
Level 6: City-sized dimension (10 km radius)
